column2: Spin continues from the half turn to home by f101942, grid and square rigid, axes turning white. "so nothing forces a logarithm to keep the axes": the picture does the argument. Right column static. Clean.
White axes stay highlighted through a second spin on "the spin, which turns every axis": axes visibly leave their places. f102095 and f102096 near-identical, one frame apart. Clean.

Half turn reached f102258. Stage clears to grid plus circle radius 1.2 and new rows "2×2, a direction sent to a negative multiple: a real log only if A=-cI, c>0" on sentence 5: correct for real 2×2 by the Jordan pair rule. White and gold arrows match A=diag(-2,-½): white (57,0), gold head at x≈125 of tile, 2×57 left.

Key column fades in between grid and right column. Measured: white (52,22) gold (-104,-10), expected (-104,-11); white (28,48) gold head expected (181,894), seen (183,894). Dashes on the straight-back line. Text now in two columns with 21 px between them: "only the two axes go straight back" ends x≈607, right column starts 628. No overlap, densest stage in the sheet range. -I rows now sit beside the A=diag(-2,-½) rows, see P8.

Dots mark straight-back directions at left, right, top after half a sweep, which is the two axes. f102797 A=-I, gold = -white: arrows equal length. Purple arc grows only for -I: arc means every direction goes straight back. Measured white (-31,-47), gold head (31,47). Correct.
Full purple circle at f102961. "A=-cI, c>0", "half turn, equal stretch" with gold length rising 56, 66, 84 of 57: c grows from 1 to about 1.47. All on the phrase. Clean.

Hold to cue end f103124. f103203 stage swaps to "each row is one matrix, each tile a block and its stretch"; citation footer "precisely: Culver, Proc. AMS 17 (1966) 1146-1151, as stated by Higham (Handbook of Linear Algebra) and Gallier (Thm 3.4)" on the first words. Bibliographic data matches my memory of the paper, unverified here. Thm number see U3.

Rows: -1 -1 / -2 -½ / -2 -2 3 / [-1 1; 0 -1]. Green "matching pair: real log", red "no partners: no real log" arriving in order within 1 s. Correct. Old right column still on the card beside the block picture, see P8. Tiles and rows clear of the footer.
